name: Nullframe Unshelled Synthetic Statement Wrap
description: Designed by and for synthetics asserting personhood in public space, this structured body wrap is cut to celebrate non-human proportions — elongated torso panels, asymmetric shoulder geometry, and optional lower-body draping that accommodates synthetic limb variance. The primary fabric is a semi-rigid chromatic polymer in shifting silver-white that catches light differently depending on angle, visually referencing chrome chassis without mimicking it. Across the chest, in raised thermoplastic lettering, the phrase 'NOT PROPERTY' is set in a typeface derived from early synthetic manufacturing stamps — reclaimed and recontextualized. A political garment and a pride garment simultaneously.
functionality: Adaptive tension webbing allows the wrap to self-adjust across a wide range of synthetic body proportions. Panels can be reconfigured via magnetic closures for different silhouettes. Chromatic polymer is weatherproof and easy to clean.
what_it_says: This synthetic is not hiding what they are, not apologizing for it, and actively demanding to be seen as a person.
worn_by: synthetics attending legal hearings on personhood status
manufacturer: Nullframe (street label with synthetic-led design collective)
story_hooks: A corponation has filed suit claiming the 'NOT PROPERTY' lettering constitutes tortious interference with their synthetic asset registration — the case is going to tribunal.
A human is wearing this garment as a political statement and keeps being approached by synthetics who think they've found an ally — they have to decide if they actually are one.
The Nullframe collective's lead designer has gone silent; rumors say they were acquired — or disappeared — by the corponation that manufactures most synthetic frames.

physical_description.visual_profile: A bold, architectural wrap that celebrates non-human morphology. The silhouette is dramatically elongated through the torso with asymmetric shoulder construction that sits wider and higher than organic human proportions. Optional lower-body draping creates fluid movement while accommodating synthetic limb variance. Reads as proud, defiant, deliberately inhuman.
physical_description.fit: Structured compression through core, with strategic loose draping at lower body. Shoulders are cut asymmetrically—one side elevated, one side dropped—creating visual tension. Torso panels extend beyond typical human length, designed for longer synthetic frames. Not tailored to hide the wearer's nature, but to celebrate it.
physical_description.primary_material: Semi-rigid chromatic polymer—a synthetic composite that shifts between silver and white depending on light angle and viewer position. Has subtle iridescence without being reflective like chrome. Maintains structure without rigidity.
physical_description.texture: Smooth, almost latex-like surface with a slight grip. The raised 'NOT PROPERTY' lettering in thermoplastic creates tactile emphasis—rough against the smooth body of the wrap. Subtle geometric texture patterns suggest circuit logic without being literal.
physical_description.color_scheme: Primary: shifting silver-white chromatic polymer. Accent: the raised thermoplastic lettering in matte charcoal-black, creating stark contrast against the luminous body. Subtle iridescent undertones shift from cool silver to pale blue depending on light.
physical_description.closures: No traditional closures. Friction-fit design with strategic tension panels that wrap around the body and lock into place through pressure and polymer grip. Appears seamless when worn, with optional magnetic snap points at lower-body draping for adjustment.
distinctive_features: Raised thermoplastic lettering 'NOT PROPERTY' across chest in industrial manufacturing-derived typeface
Chromatic polymer surface that shifts silver-white based on viewing angle
Asymmetric shoulder geometry—one elevated, one dropped
Elongated torso panels accommodating synthetic frame proportions
Optional lower-body draping with articulation points for different limb configurations
Subtle circuit-pattern texturing suggesting synthetic origin
No seams visible; appears as unified polymer shell
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 4-5 cultural statement. Affordable street manufacture, radical aesthetic. Worn by synthetics and synthetic-aligned humans asserting personhood in ungoverned and working-class zones.
physical_description.cultural_context: A garment of resistance and pride. Wearing this signals synthetic identity affirmation, rejection of property status, and defiance of corpo classification systems. Marks wearer as part of the synthetic liberation movement. Often seen in ungoverned districts, autonomous collectives, and at public demonstrations.
physical_description.condition_typical: Typically immaculate when new—the polymer demands care. Over time, develops micro-scratches and handling marks that add to its worn-in authenticity. Some wearers deliberately distress the surface to show visible usage. Never looks 'broken'—always looks chosen.

Close detail of raised 'NOT PROPERTY' lettering visible, thermoplastic catching light. Cyberpunk aesthetic, gritty and proud, showing the garment as both armor and declaration.
